subject: Gatekeeper rota, doc liaisons, and exception triage for Project Atlas launch
messages:
From: tessa_morgan@redwood.ai
To: markus_klein@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-07-28T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Gatekeeper rota + doc liaisons for Project Atlas (take-1)

Hi all,

We need to lock the week-of Launch X ops surface: specifically a short gatekeeper rota (on-call for rollout gating decisions), doc liaisons for each customer-facing doc set, and a lightweight exception triage flow so we can accept/decline last-minute feature exceptions.

Ask: please 1) confirm if you can be a gatekeeper for one 4-hour window during launch week, 2) volunteer as a doc liaison for one of the areas below, and 3) flag any hard constraints (e.g., blocked by legal, compliance, or marketplace dates).

Suggested doc areas (shuffle as needed):
- Quickstart / Getting started guides
- Console how-to & routes
- Troubleshooting / KB
- Sales enablement one-pagers

I attached a very small CSV to collect rota windows and a draft triage matrix. No need to fill every cell — I’ll consolidate on Friday.

Thanks — short replies OK.

Tessa Morgan
Director, Product Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: gatekeeper_rota_v1.csv (stub), exception_triage_matrix.xlsx (stub)

Subject: Re: Gatekeeper rota + doc liaisons for Project Atlas (take-1)

Agree with Markus that we need to define gatekeeper authority. My proposal (short):
- Gatekeeper can pause non-critical rollout actions (feature flags, routing changes) for up to 30 minutes to assess impact.
- For pauses >30 minutes or any cross-region rollback we escalate to Infra & Eng leads (Markus + Ops).
- Any data-retention / security exception must route through Legal + Security immediately (no gatekeeper unilateral approval).

Attached is a compact exception triage matrix — fields: severity, affected surface, suggested action, immediate owner. Use as the single source for accept/decline calls.

Vivek
Head of Reliability

Attachments: exception_triage_matrix.xlsx (stub)

Nice progress — consolidated update below and next steps. Please treat this as the official launch ops plan until we publish the runbook next week.

Consolidated items:
- Gatekeeper rota (confirmed):
  * Aug 3, 10:00-14:00 PT — markus_klein (veto ability for non-critical toggles, see escalation below)
  * Aug 3, 14:00-18:00 PT — vivek_kulkarni (focus on reliability & rollback)
  * Aug 4, 09:00-13:00 PT — ben_carter (customer comms & procurement questions)

- Doc liaisons & links: (see Monica’s roster). Monica will publish the Quickstart checklist by Aug 2 COB.

- Exception triage (short flow):
  * Minor (UI text, examples): liaison owner decides, log in triage matrix.
  * Major (feature change, routing): Gatekeeper pause -> 30-min review -> escalate to Eng + Infra.
  * Security/compliance/data-retention: immediate Legal + Security review (no unilateral approvals).

Action items (owners):
- Monica: publish Quickstart checklist (due Aug 2 COB) — doc_liaison_roster.md attached.
- Markus: prepare post-mortem template and confirm infra contacts (due Aug 2 EOD).
- Vivek: finalize triage matrix and share final workbook (done).
- Ben: confirm Acme SSO doc changes and procurement timeline with Matthew (due Aug 3).
- Tessa: publish runbook + share Drive link (due Aug 4 morning).

Attachments published: gatekeeper_rota_v1.csv, exception_triage_matrix.xlsx, doc_liaison_roster.md.

If anything changes, reply all and mark the item you’re updating. Thanks for quick turn-around.

Tessa Morgan
